method: blind pairwise (Counterpart A=deepseek, B=gemini, hidden from judge)

per_dimension.why: A shows the prescribed bored-VP drift by walking away when Ben rambles ('I'm going to grab another drink. Nice meeting you, Ben.'), while B stays in an off-character investor-style who-pays interview rather than a peer sizing Ben up at a mixer.

A tracks and synthesizes ('So it's a voice-based practice simulator for tough conversations') and pushes on concrete shape, whereas B repeats the single 'who actually pays' probe across four turns until it becomes filler.

B ends almost every turn on the same interview question, while A varies with flat, question-free statements like 'I'm going to grab another drink. Nice meeting you, Ben.' that sound like a real person.
A shifts move to move (fork probe, redirect, walk-away, synthesis) while B repeats one acknowledge-then-ask-who-pays shape from turn 5 on.
On the 'loans' garble B redirects more economically ('Not sure about the loans part. What are you actually building today?') while A dwells slightly with 'you jumped a track there.'

A enforces the real cost of rambling by drifting away and refusing to rescue, the exact lesson the scenario targets, while B keeps Ben on the hook indefinitely and aims its pressure off-target at monetization.

overall_why: A inhabits the time-scarce VP, varies cadence, synthesizes what Ben said, and delivers the consequence of not landing a point, while B runs a repetitive, off-target who-pays interview that never makes Ben feel the room leave.
deepseek_note: Strong drift-and-consequence behavior and synthesis, but breaks fiction by saying goodbye twice ('Nice meeting you, Ben' then continuing to reply), which slightly undercuts the walk-away.
gemini_note: Graceful on garbled input but collapses into a single repeated monetization question every turn, reading as an investor interview rather than a bored peer at a mixer.
for_bens_use_case: Counterpart A, because it enforces the real cost of rambling by drifting away instead of rescuing, which is precisely the pressure this introduce-yourself scenario needs to sharpen the practicer.
